author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಜ್ಞಾನಿ ಸಾಧಕ ಗುರುವು ಹಿರಿಯ ಜೀವಗಳೆದುರು
ನಾನೆಂಬ ಮಮಕಾರದಿಂದ ಬೀಗದಿರು
ಮಾನಿಸುತ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಗೌರವಿಸೆ ಅನುಭವವ
ಭಾನಗಡಿಯಿರದೆಂದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

ಭಾನಗಡಿ-ತೊಡಕು, ಗೊಂದಲ, ಜಟಿಲತೆ

lines: Before the wise, the seekers, the guru and the elders,
do not swagger with the attachment called ‘I’;
if you honour their practice and respect their experience,
there will be no tangles, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Drop the ego in the presence of the learned, the devoted, teachers and elders. Respecting their experience keeps life free of complications.
en.note: Kusha’s own gloss: bhānagaḍi means complication, confusion, entanglement.
